**Pipe Organ Maintenance Guild: Register Extract**

**Artisans**
- Hesper Allendale

**Organs in the guild's care**
- Harcourt Memorial Hall Organ. Custodian hall: Holy Trinity Church. Steward hall: Ashworth Academy Chapel. Built 1958. Wind pressure 78.5 mm water column. 42 stops.
- Our Lady of the Marshes Chancel Organ. Custodian hall: Ashworth Academy Chapel. Steward hall: Christ Church. Build year not recorded. Wind pressure 93.0 mm water column. 4 stops.
- Westbrook Methodist Chapel Organ. Custodian hall: Christ Church. No steward hall recorded. Build year not recorded. Wind pressure 100.0 mm water column. 22 stops.

**Standing roles** (no closing date is recorded for any of them)
- Bram Kettleworth acts as voicer on Harcourt Memorial Hall Organ, from 2020-02-10.
- Odile Marchetti acts as voicer on Westbrook Methodist Chapel Organ, from 2021-04-12.
- Tobias Wrenfield acts as lead_tuner on Our Lady of the Marshes Chancel Organ, from 2019-09-16.
- Hesper Allendale acts as restorer on Ravensworth Town Hall Organ, from 2020-06-22.
- Bram Kettleworth acts as restorer on Harcourt Memorial Hall Organ, from 2021-04-12.
- Odile Marchetti acts as voicer on Harcourt Memorial Hall Organ, from 2020-02-10.
- Odile Marchetti acts as voicer on St. Aldhelm Cathedral Great Organ, from 2019-03-04.
- Tobias Wrenfield acts as lead_tuner on Our Lady of the Marshes Chancel Organ, from 2021-04-12. This entry replaces an earlier statement about the same record. The changed property is the organ.

**Site visits**
- TUNE-STM-01: Tobias Wrenfield at St. Aldhelm Cathedral Great Organ on 2024-06-11. Labour 4.0 hours. Fee 64000 minor units, GBP. Report filed 2025-09-09.
- WIND-LEAK-02: Hesper Allendale at Westbrook Methodist Chapel Organ on 2026-09-22. Labour 4.0 hours. Fee 18750 minor units, PLN. Report filed 2026-10-06.
- ANNUAL-ELY-04: Tobias Wrenfield at Westbrook Methodist Chapel Organ on 2025-05-14. Labour 12.0 hours. Fee 96000 minor units, CZK. No report date recorded.
- PEDAL-FIX-05: Tobias Wrenfield at Our Lady of the Marshes Chancel Organ on 2026-02-03. Labour 19.5 hours. Fee 72000 minor units, HUF. No report date recorded.
